## Self-check {#sec-NN-self-check}

::: {.callout-note}
## Check your understanding in Canvas

These questions are also available as a self-marking quiz in Canvas:
**[Chapter NN self-check quiz](CANVAS-QUIZ-URL-PLACEHOLDER)** *(link added
once the quiz is imported — see `canvas-export/README.md`)*.
:::

**Q1** *(tests @sec-NN-some-section · basic)*
Which of the following statements about … is correct?

a. First option
b. Second option
c. Third option
d. Fourth option

**Q2** *(tests @sec-NN-some-section · basic)*
In one or two sentences: what is …?

**Q3** *(tests @sec-NN-other-section · applied)*
A colleague claims that … . Which option best explains why this is (in)correct?

a. …
b. …
c. …
d. …

**Q4** *(tests @sec-NN-other-section · basic)*
⚠️ **FLAGGED — needs knowledge not in the script:** this question currently
assumes familiarity with …, which the chapter does not cover. Rewrite the
question or extend @sec-NN-other-section before publishing.

**Q5 — applied scenario** *(tests @sec-NN-practice-box · applied)*
Building on the practice box in @sec-NN-practice-box: suppose … . Describe
how you would …, and justify each step with a concept from this chapter.
